assignment: Business case essay: Northwind loyalty app

earns: Position stated in the first paragraph
Counter-argument about older shoppers is answered
loses: Cost of the move is never weighed against the benefit
C1.justification: A clear position, but it is defended against the easiest objection only.

earns: Survey figure of 62% monthly app use is cited
loses: Falling card scans are asserted with no numbers
Data benefit is described, not shown
C2.justification: One real figure carries the whole case and the rest is assertion.

loses: No headings to separate argument from recommendation
C3.justification: Easy to follow, though short enough that structure is never really tested.

earns: Pilot size and a go or no-go threshold are given
C4.justification: Specific about the pilot but silent on cost and risk, which the rubric asks for.

strict.verdict: A tidy essay with a sensible idea, but it leans on a single statistic and skips the cost question entirely. The rubric asks for a costed recommendation with risks and this one has neither.

earns: Position stated early and held throughout
Anticipates the older-shopper objection and offers a fallback
C1.justification: A confident, consistent argument that takes the main objection seriously.

earns: Uses the company's own survey data
Links the data point to the argument
loses: Card scan decline needs a figure
C2.justification: Good instinct to use first-party data, with a few claims left unsupported.

loses: Headings would help a skim reader
C3.justification: Clear and well ordered for its length.

loses: Add a rough cost and the main risks
C4.justification: A practical, testable next step that only lacks cost and risk.

lenient.verdict: A practical case with a testable pilot and a fair answer to the obvious objection. Add a cost line and two or three risks and this moves up a band.

improvements.text: Put a number on the card scan decline and source the competitor example.
Add a rough cost for the app programme and weigh it against the expected benefit.
List the top three risks of the move with one mitigation each.
Extend the timeline past the pilot to a full rollout date.

methodology: Illustrative output. The scores show the JSON shape the two professor agents return and were written by hand for this demo from a fictional essay and rubric.
